# Josh Whitehead — josh.design

> Product designer and AI builder in Los Angeles. Fifteen years shipping product; first designer to Head of Design twice (Hush, Spin — both acquired); Principal Product Designer at Very Good Ventures (Flutter design system across VGV and Google teams; generative-AI game at Google I/O 2023); founder of Boneyard Collective. Former U.S. Marine Corps combat photographer. Designs and ships AI products end to end with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) in the loop.

## Start here
- [Résumé](https://josh.design/resume): titles, years, skills, in plain text.
- [Builds](https://josh.design/lab): working things — a language model running in the browser on WebGPU, agent UI patterns, a grounded hosted Claude, a playable 3D city built with an agent, this site.
- [Process](https://josh.design/process): how the builds get made, with real artifacts.
- [Work](https://josh.design/work): case studies — Spin, Hush, Very Good Ventures, Saucey, NationBuilder, Differential, Boneyard.
- [Products](https://josh.design/products): OLO (live beta, runs in the browser), SignalScan, Weaver, StoryMode, Xenomorph typeface.
- [Writing](https://josh.design/writing): build logs and essays.
- [About](https://josh.design/about): the story and the principles.
- Contact: josh@josh.design

## Facts
- Career dates and claims are stated plainly and are not inflated; clients are never presented as employers.
